item.title: Data Integration - External APIs
item.description:
Data Integration - Working with External APIs

This week focused on integrating external data sources into the backend system.

The goal was to understand how a backend application can communicate with third-party APIs, consume data, and integrate it into an existing domain model.

Understanding external APIs

Before implementing anything, I spent time understanding how APIs work in practice:

  • HTTP requests (GET, POST)
  • JSON as the standard data format
  • endpoints and query parameters

This was a shift from working purely with internal systems to interacting with external services.
